source_boundary.scope_hash_format: UTF-8 sorted exact IDs joined by LF, including final LF
source_boundary.UI_lease: Presentation.show allocates a unique CallbackLeases.Lease, wraps each callback and reserved closed callback, transfers positive C handles only after Runtime.uiPresent returns id. PluginUILeaseStore retains captured CallbackOwner/account scope/revision. Runtime callback binding supplies the worker gate; PluginCallbackDispatcher orders callback and release. Failed admission rolls back SDK handles; terminal delivery and release retain native quota until FIFO admission.
source_boundary.settings_lease: Manager settings use Host expectedOwner/read/action guards and SDK account index. cb_/lc_ IDs reference PluginRecord callbacks, not C handle numbers. Portable show_settings instead owns one Presentation(settings) with change/action/longAction/refresh C wrappers and the UI lease above.
source_boundary.UI_bounds: 512 KiB JSON; depth 24; 128 callback entries; default 16 presentations/plugin and 128 total. Model title <=4096 UTF-16, message/text <=65536, subtitle <=16384; buttons <=3, nonempty text <=1024; items <=256, text/subtext <=4096. Native images are explicit aliases, sf: names or bundle: relative paths, <=256 UTF-8; unavailable images fail ResourceUnavailable.
source_boundary.settings_bounds: Manager document: 1 MiB, 1000 rows, depth 16, selector <=1000 choices. Portable UI: 512 widgets, depth 8, selector <=256 choices, input max_length 0...65536 (default 16384), slider bounds +/-1e12 and step 1e-12...1e12. Native settings storage: keys 1...256 UTF-8 without NUL; per-plugin JSON <=1 MiB. Display schema is unproven dynamic metadata, not backup authority.
source_boundary.route_conventions: original is the exact checked-in SDK declaration; route starts with its consumed body/override and ends at the concrete data consumer/provider. metadata rows describe real stored/serialized fields, not abstract APIs. install.X identifies the local X defined in that module's install function. No Python/JVM class-name equality is treated as UIKit support.
